threshold_purpose: illustrative demo operating setting, not a regulatory or health limit
event_rule: five consecutive available one-second snapshots at or above threshold; onset is first snapshot; separate runs need a 60-second onset cooldown
warning_rule: endpoint forecast at or above threshold while current observed snapshot is below threshold
matching_rule: greedy one-to-one in time order; event onset must be strictly after warning and at most 30 seconds later
lead_time_definition: event onset minus first matched warning issue time
eligibility_rule: only events with a complete 30-second preceding set of eligible forecast issue times are scored
scope: descriptive event counts only; single endpoint does not estimate exact crossing ETA
